parameters.query: select jsonb_object_agg(key, value) as cfg from app_config;

-- Closes the run-log row of the execution that failed (it never reached its own "finish" step).
-- Parameters in order: workflow name, execution id, error text. No row is touched when the workflow has no run-log row.
UPDATE workflow_runs
SET status = 'failed',
    finished_at = now(),
    notes = left(COALESCE(notes || ' | ', '') || 'failed: ' || $3, 400)
WHERE workflow = $1 AND execution_id = $2 AND finished_at IS NULL;
